title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: customers in regulated industries require strict controls tying KMS key usage to allowed regions and full audit trails for encryption operations. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time and hardens audit logging around key unwrap/wrap operations. Summary of changes: - Add a new KMS residency constraint type to RBAC v2 (policy schema + evaluator). - Wire KMS region metadata into policy evaluation pipeline and reject non-compliant requests early. - Capture detailed audit events for KMS operations (key id, region, caller, decision path) and surface them to the audit log backend with structured fields. - Migration: DB migration to add kms_region column to kms_key_metadata table and one-time backfill job. - Tests: unit and integration tests for policy evaluation, plus an e2e test exercising a simulated cross-region request. Checklist: - [x] Policy schema + validator implemented - [x] Evaluation path integrated into request authorization middleware - [x] Audit events emitted and conform to audit schema - [x] DB migration + backfill implemented and tested on staging - [x] Updated docs and operator migration notes - [x] Security review and threat model updated Rollout plan: staged rollout to dedicated clusters, enable audit logging by default for enterprise orgs, soft-fail mode (audit-only) for 48h to collect telemetry, then strict enforcement. Related: ENG-4123 (policy work), SEC-88 (threat model), SUP-1023 (customer report).

merge_commit_message:
security: enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 evaluation + audit logging hardening

Summary: add kms residency constraint, integrate into authorization middleware, emit structured audit events, DB migration and backfill, tests, docs.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and improve KMS audit logging. Operators must run the provided DB migration and backfill before enabling strict enforcement. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for migration and rollback instructions.
testing: Unit tests cover policy schema and evaluator. Integration tests exercise middleware with simulated KMS metadata. Staging rollout performed on dedicated clusters with audit-only mode for 48h, telemetry reviewed by security and SRE.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: incorrect metadata backfill could block key operations in strict mode. Mitigation: soft-fail (audit-only) rollout for 48h, backfill job includes verification steps, operator rollback documented.
notes_for_ops: Run deploy/migrations/2026_02_14_add_kms_region.sql, then tools/backfill/kms_region_backfill --verify. Toggle enforcement via feature flag feature.kms_region_enforce on the control plane. Watch audit.kms.* metrics for rejections.
additional_context: This PR follows prior work in ENG-4123 to generalize constraint types in RBAC v2. We intentionally keep enforcement behind a feature flag to coordinate operator migrations and infra readiness.
